title: Marita G NDE 1115
content:
I had swollen lungs, so I couldn't lie on my back. I didn't have any asthma medication. I went to bed, had trouble breathing, couldn't breathe fully. Then I fell asleep and experienced that I saw myself lying there. I saw someone who pressed down on my lungs, as a kind of CPR. My head was being held up sideways and I felt an arm around my neck on the side I was lying on. I felt rough pressures down my back and saw two hands pressing on my back at the same time. I remember a person who passed away a long time ago, who had thin brown hands and a light blue shirt - that's what I saw. I woke up from it and couldn't breathe properly.

I remember a person who passed away a long time ago, who had thin brown hands and a light blue shirt - that's what I saw. I woke up from it and couldn't breathe properly.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Allergic reaction Life threatening event, but not clinical death Since my lungs were about to shut down totally, it was life threatening.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I looked the same way I do now.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: But felt rough pressure down my back, was pushed around hard until I woke up.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future I have this ability and all the events are correct, all the events I get information about are important and big.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Conservative/fundamentalist Men tror på existens efter livet.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes Body and soul are separate and the soul has to exist for us to be able to walk, talk, and do things. When the soul is gone, you can't exist in the body you have on earth. The body is only a shell; the soul is the important part, the part that survives bodily death.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Uncertain I've had it all along, but it's deeper now. I get signs about people I'm about to meet and what I'm going to do in my life. It can be about work, health etc. I know things that are going to happen to all my friends, and everyone I meet. Because I see it while I'm asleep, and the things come true as well. I take medicine for my asthma now.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: There is no worst part. I know I have something else to fulfill before I meet my loved ones, and that they are always with me, even if they're not earth bound.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes My family thought it would have been awful if I'd passed away.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: Everything happened so fast, I was simply forced to wake up. And there was more than one helper. It all felt safe and pleasant.
